author: Trending Desk
title: Viral Instagram Reel showing street food vendor in Mumbai sparks nationwide safety debate
description: A food safety reel recorded at a popular chowpatty stall in Mumbai, Maharashtra surpassed 40 million views on Instagram, prompting state food safety inspections.
content: Instagram creators across Mumbai are remixing the original viral reel with contrasting hygiene reviews.

author: Express Web Desk
title: Bengaluru techie's viral Instagram Reel on suburban train commute goes viral
description: Commuters in Bengaluru, Karnataka celebrate a creative Instagram video highlighting quick rail transfers that beat Outer Ring Road traffic gridlock.
content: The clip has struck a chord with hundreds of thousands of daily office goers across the Karnataka capital.
